description: Collect this epoch's batch of blind-signed pseudonym creation tokens.

main.description: Approved, non-pseudonym accounts submit blinded messages and receive blind signatures. One collection per epoch.

blindedMessages.description: Exactly the configured tokens-per-epoch count of base64url blinded messages.

errors.name: WrongEpoch
errors.description: The epoch is not the current UTC month.

errors.name: AlreadyCollected
errors.description: Tokens for this epoch were already collected.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Pseudonym accounts cannot collect creation tokens.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Wrong batch size or malformed blinded messages.
